title: A First Job Interview
introduction: در این متن با چند عبارت کاربردی برای معرفی خود در یک مصاحبه آشنا می‌شوی.
paragraphs: A job interview can feel stressful, especially when it is your first one. Preparing a few clear sentences can make the experience easier.
Start with a short introduction. You can say, “My name is Alex, and I recently finished school.” Then talk about your skills and interests.
For example: “I am organized, I enjoy working with people, and I learn new tasks quickly.” Give one simple example when you describe a skill.
At the end, thank the interviewer for their time. You can ask, “What are the next steps in the process?” Speak clearly and take a moment to think before you answer.
